text:
jo (product): Heads-up: BigBank asked for an A/B cutover of a new summarization model in Private (EU) that must be billing-aware. They want A/B for quality, canary for latency, and an automatic fallback that won't bill customers during shadow.

lee (eng): Can you clarify "billing-aware"? Do they want zero billing during shadow or a separate billing tag?

rachel (sales): They said zero billing for shadow, then normal billing once switched. Also need an exportable audit CSV for finance reconciliation.

sam (sre): Operationally: need per-tenant cost caps and an enforcement hook that flips variant -> fallback when cost_per_minute exceeds X. Also quota isolation so one tenant doesn't exhaust shared caches.

lee (eng): We can implement 3 routing variants: shadow (no billing), canary (1% billed), active (100% billed). Routing flag maps tenant -> variant. Runtime must attach a billing_label to requests.

tom (legal): Export spec: CSV with timestamp, tenant_id, variant, token_count, cost_estimate, signature_hash. Need retention policy note for auditors.

jo (product): Proposed rollout flow: shadow 72h (no billing) -> A/B split 10/90 for quality comparison (billed for the 10) -> canary at 10% billed -> 50% -> 100%. Auto-fallback if quality delta negative OR cost guardrail trips.

lee (eng): Quality gate: automated eval on 1k sampled requests/day; metric = summary_coherence_score. If new model < baseline by > 3 points -> rollback. Latency gate: p99 <= baseline + 50ms. Cost gate: cost_per_tenant_hour increase <= +15%.

sam (sre): Add emergency rollback trigger: external API that sales/legal can call to flip a tenant back to active-old. Also require a runbook entry and oncall page links.

rachel (sales): Sales want a short, non-technical playbook to give customer admins: "How to opt-out of pilot", "How to request audit export", "SLA expectations during pilot".

lee (eng): Implementation note: billing_label requires minor schema change on request headers and a DB column in billing pipeline. Low-risk but needs billing team sign-off.

tom (legal): We'll need a DPA addendum for shadow data handling. Customer must approve logged fields.

jo (product): Timeline constraints: BigBank expects pilot start in 2.5 weeks. Can we do the minimal path (routing flag + billing_label + runbook) in that window?

lee (eng): Minimal path doable if we reuse existing flag infra. Billing pipeline change is the blocker; estimate 6 dev-days. If billing sign-off delayed, we can run shadow with internal meters and produce manual CSV.

sam (sre): For auto-fallback, recommend two modes: soft-fallback (route new requests to old model but keep metrics) and hard-fallback (route and stop billing). Soft fallback first while ops investigates.

rachel (sales): Customer insists on hard-fallback capability. They want assurance billing stops immediately for that tenant.

lee (eng): We'll implement a hard-fallback switch that sets variant=old and sets billing_label=manual_hold. Need billing team to honor manual_hold.

tom (legal): Also request: export should be SHA256 hashed before leaving infra. We'll add to spec.

jo (product): Action items: 1) Lee: write minimal rollout config + estimate (due EOD tomorrow). 2) Sam: draft runbook + alert rules (due in 48h). 3) Tom: DPA addendum draft for customer review (72h). 4) Rachel: confirm pilot acceptance criteria with BigBank (soon).

rachel (sales): I'll get tenant IDs and security contacts by Friday. Also confirm they accept manual CSV for the first run if needed.

deploy-bot: Note: feature-flag branch builds passing. No infra jobs blocked.

jo (product): Ok. We'll treat this as a templated manual workflow for now; log ops time and revisit GA effort if we see repeated demand. Keeping this thread for coordination. Ping me if blockers. :handshake:
